related_metadata.scope: Publicly visible third-party diagnostic manual indexes; no full OEM manual purchased/accessed. Includes ATTO 3 2022-23, Qin L DM-i 2024, Sealion 07 EV 2024; not whole BYD.
caveats: All records are pending OEM verification; visible index verifies that the title is indexed by secondary publisher, not BYD officially.
Numerical measurement thresholds, pinouts, part numbers, symptom/setting conditions are unavailable and intentionally not invented.
Live data names are suggested functional labels and must not be treated as scan-tool PID names.
No real-world workshop frequency rankings are claimed.
No GitHub upload or DTC NEXIS app integration has occurred.
No assumption that all manufacturer DTCs are available through emissions OBD.
